It launched on pump.fun around 07:17 UTC. It spiked to an all-time high of about $0.0014 (roughly $1.4M market cap, per GMGN), then fell about 78% in 5 minutes. It now sits around $270k market cap with $46k liquidity, about 23 minutes after launch. The packet's own website link points to a different contract (HSnC…, the usepaid.app page). That makes HSnC… the likely original, and it is at about $1.65M market cap. Other clones have traded $4M–$14M of volume in one hour. This token is the 'next clone' in a clone-farming rotation.
